env KCLI_CONFIG_HOME=$WORK/config
env KCLI_STATE_HOME=$WORK/state
env KCLI_CACHE_HOME=$WORK/cache

exec kcli schema show listing get
stdout '"side_effect": "none"'
! stderr .

exec kcli schema show seller get
stdout '"evidence": "provisional"'
! stderr .

! exec kcli schema show dm reply
stdout '"schema": "kcli.error/v1"'
stdout '"code": "invalid_schema"'

! exec kcli dm poll --since now
stdout '"code": "invalid_command"'

! exec kcli auth login --help
stdout '"code": "invalid_command"'

exec kcli listing get --help
stdout '^Usage: kcli listing get <id-or-url> \[flags\]$'
! stderr .

exec kcli search --help
stdout '^Usage: kcli search \[<query>\] \[flags\]$'
! stderr .
